briefing: Markets drifted lower today in a neutral session (NASDAQ -0.7%, S&P 500 -0.4%), with no strong risk-on signal to justify new capital deployment. Cash sits at $489.29, just under the $500 buy threshold, so per prior lessons we held all 7 existing positions and waited rather than forcing a buy on a low-conviction day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: 'Dry powder' refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely attractive opportunity appears. Today's cash balance was just under the buy threshold and the market showed no strong risk-on signal, so holding that cash in reserve — rather than forcing a purchase — is the disciplined move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者預留在場邊的現金，待出現真正吸引的機會時才動用。今日現金餘額剛好低於買入門檻，加上市場未見明顯的風險偏好訊號，因此保留現金、不勉強進場，才是紀律性的做法。

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 slipped modestly today, reflecting a mild pullback rather than any dramatic shift in sentiment. Moves of under 1% like this are typical day-to-day noise and don't signal a change in the broader trend. No major news catalysts were flagged for today's session.
market_education.summary_zh: 納指及標普500今日均溫和下跌，屬於正常的市場波動而非情緒逆轉的訊號。這種不足1%的細幅回落屬於日常雜訊，未反映大趨勢出現變化，今日亦未有重大新聞觸發事件。
